claims.source_quote_ar: وَقَالَ الْكُوفِيُّونَ: مِنَ الثَّقِيلَةِ «إِنْ» بِمَعْنَى «مَا» ، وَقَدْ ذُكِرَ فِي الْبَقَرَةِ عِنْدَ قَوْلِهِ: (وَإِنْ كَانَتْ لَكَبِيرَةً) .
claims.claim_ar: قَالَ الكوفيونُ: إنْ هنا من «الثَّقِيلَةِ» وتُؤوَّلُ بمعنى «مَا» في قوله: (وَإِنْ كَانَتْ لَكَبِيرَةً).
claims.claim_en: The Kufans hold that the particle 'إِنْ' here is the heavy type (إنّ الثقيلة) and is to be understood as meaning 'ما' in the clause (وَإِنْ كَانَتْ لَكَبِيرَةً).
claims.needs_review_reason: Interpretation 'بمعنى مَا' is a specialized grammatical reading; requires review by a specialist to confirm how this affects the clause's syntax and semantics in this verse.

claims.source_quote_ar: وَإِنْ وَجَدْنَا : مُخَفَّفَةٌ مِنَ الثَّقِيلَةِ، وَاسْمُهَا مَحْذُوفٌ؛ أَيْ: وَإِنَّا وَجَدْنَا.
claims.claim_ar: تُذكرُ أيضاً أنَّ «إِنْ» في أمثلةٍ مثل «وَإِنْ وَجَدْنَا» تكون مخففةً من الثقيلة واسمها محذوف، أي تُفهم كـ «وَإِنَّا وَجَدْنَا».
claims.claim_en: The text gives a grammatical rule: in forms like 'وَإِنْ وَجَدْنَا' the particle 'إِنْ' is the light (mukhafafa) form of the heavy 'إِنْ', with its ism omitted (i.e., understood as 'وإنا وجدنا').
claims.needs_review_reason: General rule stated in the source; applicability to this specific occurrence of 'وَإِنْ' in the verse should be confirmed (whether this instance is heavy or light).

warnings: The provided source chunks discuss the particle إِنْ (heavy vs. light) in relation to this verse, but they do not provide explicit i'rab assignments for other words of the ayah (e.g., مبتدأ/خبر, فاعل/مفعول). Extraction limited to claims about إِنْ.
